mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 71 degree weather with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. Under this waning crescent moon, we have a clear view of the International Space Station tonight starting at 9:05 PM, passing from the southwest near Mount Horeb toward the east northeast heading toward the Fitchburg and Madison area for two minutes. The overnight low will be 63 degrees with no rain expected.

In city updates, the Verona Police Department has arrested a Madison teacher following an investigation into reports of an inappropriate relationship from 2019. Meanwhile, road construction on Highway M continues, with traffic shifting and lane closures expected to facilitate utility work through the end of the month.

We have plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia or Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee, and don't forget the Verona downtown farmers market taking place tomorrow at Hometown Junction Park.

The Verona Police Department reported an arrest on September 4 regarding an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30, involving a school staff member and an inappropriate relationship with a student.
You can still stop by Culver's tonight to grab today's delicious flavor of the day, Georgia Peach, before they close their doors at 10 PM.
